race.comment: FORSAKEN (11) has the most persuasive recent profile after finishing second at Wyong, beaten just under two lengths, when prominent and strong through the line. She was also tightened early when fifth at Kembla the run prior, so third-up with a placing from her only try at this distance gives her a solid winning platform. VISION IN A DREAM (10) has to rebound from a seventh at Hawkesbury when well found in betting, but her earlier Kembla third reads well and she has two placings from three starts around 1600m. PRINCE OF THUNDER (6) has trialled in town and his 1000m heat at Hawkesbury last month was solid. The mile fresh looks a good move on what we've seen publicly and he's not to be discounted. BROZINO (5) improved nicely out in trip last start when closing well at Wagga. Out to a mile now can see him right in the finish.
